name: Preserving Knowledge
summary: In Southshore, Loremaster Dibbs sends you to recover books from the Ruins of Alterac. Ogres have settled among the precious volumes left there, and one worn leather book matters most: it holds The Arm of Gri'lek, a work of ancient troll lore.

sections.title: Books in Ogre Hands
sections.body: Loremaster Dibbs fears for the books in the Ruins of Alterac, where ogres have made their home. You are to search for the tomes they have looted and recover what you can. Dibbs would climb into the mountains to search as well, but fears old bones would not survive the journey.

sections.title: The Arm of Gri'lek
sections.body: Among the tomes, Loremaster Dibbs most wants a worn leather book containing The Arm of Gri'lek. Dibbs is bent on learning the ancient troll lore inside, and the Ruins of Alterac were the last known home of an intact copy.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs, in Southshore, offers it.

faq.q: What specific book is Loremaster Dibbs searching for?
faq.answer: Dibbs seeks the worn leather volume containing The Arm of Gri'lek, a work of ancient troll lore.

aliases: where is the arm of gri'lek
faq.answer: The books are in the Ruins of Alterac, where ogres have settled and looted the tomes. The ruins were the last known home of an intact copy of The Arm of Gri'lek.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs want books from Alterac?
aliases: what does dibbs want with books
faq.answer: Dibbs fears what the ogres may be doing to the precious books in the ruins and wants to recover what can be saved. Dibbs wants The Arm of Gri'lek most, to learn its ancient troll lore.
